tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
- The recorded browser session navigated Magento 1.9 admin, logged in, opened product edit id=2796, edited name, sku, weight, price, status, visibility, qty, stock availability and manage_stock, navigated tabs (Prices, Inventory, Categories), attempted category toggle, and used Save / Save and Continue. The Categories tree is AJAX/ExtJS-driven and the 'Use Config' checkboxes and category checkboxes can differ across installs; they require runtime checks. The recorded run produced stable name/id patterns for many fields (e.g., input#name, input#sku, input#weight, select#status, select#visibility, input[name='product[stock_data][qty]'], select[name='product[stock_data][manage_stock]']).

Task Definition:
- Create a reusable, parameterized tool that: navigates to a specific Magento admin product edit page, updates specified product fields (general, inventory), optionally toggles a single category by id, and demonstrates header actions (Save or Save and Continue, Duplicate, Delete). It must use robust selectors (name/id-based) and agentic verification for dynamic elements (use-config checkboxes and ExtJS category tree).

Action Plan:
1) Navigate to product edit URL using product_id.
2) Update general fields (name, sku, weight, price, status, visibility) using name/id-based selectors.
3) Open Inventory tab and use an agent step to safely uncheck 'Use Config Manage Stock' (if requested), set Manage Stock and Qty values, accounting for radios/select fallback.
4) Open Categories tab and use an agent step to find and toggle the category checkbox by value {category_id} (or by label inside the Default Category subtree) — verify checked state before clicking.
5) Use an agent step to perform final header actions per inputs: Save/Save and Continue, optionally Duplicate (no confirm), optionally click Delete (do not accept confirm). Capture success messages.
6) Extract final page messages and return them as output.

Variable Identification:
- product_id (required): used to build the admin edit URL and to scope tab links.
- name, sku, weight, price, status, visibility: general fields to set (optional).
- qty, manage_stock, unset_use_config_manage_stock: inventory controls.
- category_id, toggle_category: category id to toggle and whether to toggle it.
- do_save_and_continue, do_duplicate, do_delete: control final header actions.

Step Optimization:
- Prefer direct navigation to the edit URL to avoid clicking through the grid; use URL parameter product_id.
- Use name-based selectors for stock_data inputs (product[stock_data][...]) since they are most stable across Magento installs.
- For uncertain or dynamic pieces (use_config checkboxes, category tree), use agentic steps that probe element states (checked/disabled) and act only when necessary to avoid blind toggles.
- Scope searches inside the product form (#product_form) and tabs container (#product_tabs) where possible to avoid false matches.
- Extract and return page messages to confirm success.

Assumptions & Safety:
- The session represented in the recording was authenticated; this tool assumes the caller executes in an authenticated session.
- The tool will not accept Delete confirmation dialogs automatically (to avoid destructive actions without human oversight). Duplicate is expected to run without confirmation.
- The tool does not rebuild indexes or flush caches; it only edits product data and triggers standard admin actions.

Selectors & Determinism:
- Use exact selectors where Magento conventions apply (input#name, input#sku, select#status, select#visibility, input[name='product[stock_data][qty]'], select[name='product[stock_data][manage_stock]'], input[name*='use_config_manage_stock'], input[name='category_ids[]'][value='{category_id}']).
- Agent steps handle variations and confirm states before mutating UI elements to avoid inconsistent toggles.

Why agent steps are used:
- Category tree and 'Use Config Settings' checkboxes are rendered dynamically by JS and can be styled/hidden. Agentic steps let the automation inspect element.checked / disabled properties and only perform clicks when needed, keeping the tool robust.

This tool focuses only on the required flows: edit fields, inventory management, category toggle, and header actions. It avoids unrelated steps such as index rebuild or cache operations, which are out of scope for a single product edit operation.
name: magento_admin_edit_product_tool
description: Edit a Magento 1.x product in the Admin panel: navigate to the product edit page, update core fields (name, sku, weight, price, status, visibility), update inventory (manage_stock, qty), toggle a category by id, and perform header actions (Save, Save and Continue Edit, Duplicate, Delete). Uses robust name/id-based selectors and agentic verification steps for dynamic controls (use-config checkboxes, category tree). The caller must supply product_id and may supply any fields to modify. The agent is already authenticated in the recorded session.

steps.description: Open the Magento admin product edit page for the given product_id.
Short wait to allow the edit form and admin JS to initialize.
Open the Inventory tab to access stock fields.
Wait for Inventory tab content to render.

Agentic step: 1) if {unset_use_config_manage_stock} is true, locate input[name*='use_config_manage_stock'] and uncheck it if checked. 2) If {manage_stock} provided, set select[name*='manage_stock'] (or matching radios) to {manage_stock}. 3) If {qty} provided, set input[name*='stock_data'][name*='qty'] to {qty}. This handles variations in markup and enables/disables fields as needed.
steps.task: Ensure Use Config Manage Stock is unchecked when requested and set Manage Stock and Qty values as provided

steps.description: Open the Categories tab/overlay for category assignment.
Wait for the category tree to be visible and any AJAX loaders to disappear.
Dynamic category tree handling: finds the exact checkbox to toggle; disambiguates multiple 'Accessories' nodes, and ensures the correct node (Default Category > Accessories) is used.
steps.task: Locate the category checkbox for id {category_id} under the product categories tree and toggle it only if {toggle_category} is true. Use input[name='category_ids[]'][value='{category_id}'] or fall back to label-based XPath under the 'Default Category' subtree. Verify the checkbox 'checked' state and click only if a change is needed.

steps.description: Agentic finalization step: handles Save vs Save and Continue, Duplicate and Delete flows and avoids destructive confirmation acceptance for Delete.
steps.task: Perform post-change header actions according to inputs: if {do_save_and_continue} is true click 'Save and Continue Edit', otherwise click 'Save'. Then, if {do_duplicate} is true click 'Duplicate' and wait for resulting navigation. If {do_delete} is true click 'Delete' but DO NOT accept any confirmation dialog (stop before confirming). Capture success messages displayed after Save.

steps.description: Short wait to allow server to process the save/duplicate actions and display success messages.
Extract page messages (e.g., 'The product has been saved.') and current URL.
steps.goal: Capture any success or error messages after save and final page URL to confirm operation results

input_schema.name: product_id
input_schema.description: Product numeric id used in the admin edit URL (example: '2796').

input_schema.name: name
input_schema.description: Product Name (will set input#name). Leave empty to keep unchanged.

input_schema.name: sku
input_schema.description: Product SKU (will set input#sku). Leave empty to keep unchanged.

input_schema.name: weight
input_schema.description: Product weight (decimal). Sets input#weight or input[name='weight'].

input_schema.name: price
input_schema.description: Product base price (decimal). Sets input#price or input[name='price'].

input_schema.name: status
input_schema.description: Product status. Use exact visible option text (Enabled / Disabled).

input_schema.name: visibility
input_schema.description: Product visibility option - use one of the Magento admin visible texts.

input_schema.name: qty
input_schema.description: Inventory quantity to set (product[stock_data][qty]). Leave empty to keep unchanged.

input_schema.name: manage_stock
input_schema.description: Manage Stock value to set (Yes/No). If not provided, the field will be left as-is.

input_schema.name: unset_use_config_manage_stock
input_schema.description: If true, attempt to uncheck 'Use Config Settings' for Manage Stock before setting manage_stock. Defaults to false.

input_schema.name: category_id
input_schema.description: Category id to toggle on the Categories tree (example: '58'). If empty no category toggle is performed.

input_schema.name: toggle_category
input_schema.description: If true and category_id is provided, toggle (click) the category checkbox with value={category_id}. Defaults to false.

input_schema.name: do_save_and_continue
input_schema.description: If true click 'Save and Continue Edit' after changes. If false the tool will click the top Save when saving is required. Defaults to true.

input_schema.name: do_duplicate
input_schema.description: If true click the 'Duplicate' button after saves to create a copy. Automation will not accept any destructive confirmations for Duplicate (none expected). Defaults to false.

input_schema.name: do_delete
input_schema.description: If true click the 'Delete' button (which usually triggers a JS confirmation). The tool will click Delete but will NOT accept the confirmation — human must confirm. Defaults to false.
